title: The New Gate
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shin, the strongest player trapped in a deadly online game, defeats the final boss but wakes 500 years later inside the game world, now real. Hiding that he belongs to a supposedly extinct race of High Humans, he joins the Adventurers' Guild and reunites with former companions such as the high elf Schnee, who has waited centuries for him. Arcs involve monster floods, demons and duels.
life_message: Great power is best used to protect others and honor old bonds of loyalty.
